2607.01973.title: Assessing VLM Reliability for Medical Image Quality Evaluation Under Corruption and Bias
2607.01973.paper_summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly applied in medical tasks such as pathology description, report generation, and visual question answering. Medical Image Quality Assessment (MIQA) supports diagnostic accuracy and patient safety by determining whether images meet the standards required for clinical decision-making. Automating MIQA with VLMs may reduce workload, but their behavior under real-world conditions, where images may be degraded or textual context may affect judgments, should be further explored before deployment. We benchmark VLMs on medical image quality using the MediMeta-C dataset zero-shot across seven corruption types and five severity levels. We evaluate sensitivity to degradation patterns, the effect of corruptions on embedding geometry, and whether textual attributes (demographics, expertise, infrastructure, institution) alter scores. Across 16 VLMs and seven modalities, pixelation produced the largest score reductions (mean -20.58%, up to -34.4% for OCT), whereas brightness had limited effect (-0.81%). Embedding displacement was associated with score changes. Same-family models showed correlations of 0.67-0.83; some produced increases up to +31% for corrupted mammography. Textual attributes affected scores: institutional prestige raised them +17.15%, and equipment age lowered them -14.7%. The largest changes were +95.62% (InternVL-8B) and -37.7% (MedGemma). Current VLMs show limitations for medical image quality assessment. Pixelation, a privacy-preserving transformation, reduces performance, indicating a trade-off between patient privacy and reliability. Sensitivity to contextual metadata indicates limited objectivity and marks metadata as a privacy and bias source. Privacy protection and objective quality assessment are related requirements for use.
2607.01973.paper_summary_zh: 視覺語言模型（VLMs）越來越多地應用於醫療任務，如病理描述、報告生成和視覺問答。醫療影像質量評估（MIQA）通過確定影像是否符合臨床決策所需的標準，來支持診斷準確性和病人安全。使用 VLMs 自動化 MIQA 可能會減少工作負擔，但在真實世界條件下，影像可能會退化或文本上下文可能會影響判斷，這些情況應在部署之前進一步探討。我們使用 MediMeta-C 數據集對醫療影像質量進行基準測試，零樣本測試七種腐敗類型和五個嚴重程度。我們評估對退化模式的敏感性、腐敗對嵌入幾何的影響，以及文本屬性（人口統計、專業知識、基礎設施、機構）是否會改變分數。在 16 種 VLM 和七種模態中，像素化產生了最大的分數減少（平均 -20.58%，OCT 高達 -34.4%），而亮度的影響有限（-0.81%）。嵌入位移與分數變化相關。同一家族的模型顯示出 0.67-0.83 的相關性；某些模型對受損的乳腺攝影產生了高達 +31% 的增長。文本屬性影響了分數：機構聲望提高了 +17.15%，而設備年齡降低了 -14.7%。最大的變化為 +95.62%（InternVL-8B）和 -37.7%（MedGemma）。當前的 VLM 在醫療影像質量評估方面顯示出局限性。像素化作為一種保護隱私的轉換，降低了性能，表明病人隱私與可靠性之間存在權衡。對上下文元數據的敏感性表明客觀性有限，並將元數據標記為隱私和偏見的來源。隱私保護和客觀質量評估是使用的相關要求。
